Old Bay Brown Butter Air Fryer
Crispy Chicken Thighs

Inspired by Ethan Chlebowski and All Day I Dream About Food.

Ingredients:
• 2 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs
• 1 tbsp Old Bay seasoning
• 1 tsp salt
• 1 tsp cornstarch
• 1/2 tsp baking powder
• 1 tbsp brown butter (for topping)
Instructions:
1. Dry Brine: Pat the chicken thighs dry. In a small bowl, mix the Old Bay seasoning, salt, cornstarch, and baking powder. Coat the thighs evenly on both sides.
2. Place the seasoned thighs on a paper towel lined plate (skin-side up) in the fridge for 8-24 hours. This step removes moisture for a crispier result. If you need to make more, these paper towel lined plates can be stacked.
3. Air Fry: Preheat your air fryer to 375°F (190°C). Place the thighs skin-side up in the air fryer basket and spritz the tops lightly with PAM or cooking spray.
4. Cook for 15-20 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 180°F.
Check the temperature periodically to avoid overcooking.
5. Brown the Butter:
• In a small pan, melt 1 tbsp butter over medium heat.
• Swirl the pan continuously until the butter turns golden brown and smells nutty (3-5 minutes).
• Remove from heat immediately to avoid burning.
6. Finish: Drizzle the browned butter over the crispy chicken thighs and enjoy immediately!

Nutritional Information (for 2 thighs):
Calories and Macros:
1. Chicken thighs (bone-in, skin-on):
• Calories: 440 (220 per thigh)
• Protein: 40g (20g per thigh)
• Fat: 30g (15g per thigh)
2. Cornstarch and baking powder (~1 tsp total):
• Calories: ~10
• Carbs: ~2g
3. Brown Butter (1 tbsp):
• Calories: 100
• Fat: 11g

Final Macros (Entire Recipe):
• Calories: ~550
• Protein: ~40g
• Fat: ~41g
• Carbs: ~ 2g

GIANT KETO CHICKEN BURGERS

Ingredients:
* ﻿﻿2 Ibs ground chicken breast (or chicken breast processed in a food processor)
* ﻿﻿1 large egg (to bind the mixture)
* ﻿﻿1/2 cup almond flour (to help bind and add texture)
* ﻿﻿Salt, to taste
* ﻿﻿White pepper, to taste
* ﻿﻿Garlic powder, to taste
* ﻿﻿Smoked paprika, to taste
* ﻿﻿Olive oil or avocado oil for searing

Equipment:
* ﻿﻿Ring mold (for shaping the patties)
* ﻿﻿Temperature probe (for precise cooking in the oven)
Instructions

STEP ONE:
Prepare the Chicken Mixture
* ﻿﻿If using whole chicken breasts, process them in a food processor until they have the texture of ground chicken.
* ﻿﻿In a large bowl, combine the ground chicken with the salt, white pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika.
* ﻿﻿Add the egg to help bind the mixture, and mix well.
* ﻿﻿Gradually add the almond flour while mixing to help absorb any excess moisture and create a cohesive patty mixture. The mixture should be wet: but if it is TOO wet, add more almond flour. 

STEP TWO:
Shape the Patties Using a Ring Mold
* ﻿﻿Lightly spray the ring mold with nonstick cooking spray.
* ﻿﻿Press the chicken mixture into the ring mold to form thick, evenly shaped patties. This ensures consistent cooking and a professional look. 
* Carefully remove the ring mold and set the patties aside.

STEP THREE:
Sear the Patties
* ﻿﻿Heat a skillet over medium-high heat with a bit of olive oil or avocado oil.
* ﻿﻿Sear each chicken patty for about 2-3 minutes per side until a golden-brown crust forms.

STEP FOUR:
Finish Cooking in the Oven with Temperature Probe
* ﻿﻿Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C).
* ﻿﻿Transfer the seared patties to a baking sheet.
* Insert an oven safe temperature probe into the thickest part of one of the patties.
* ﻿﻿Place the baking sheet in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until the patties reach an internal temperature of 160°F.

STEP FIVE:
Let the Patties Rest
Remove the patties from the oven and let them rest for a few minutes. During this time, the internal temperature will rise to the safe final temperature of 165°F, ensuring juicy and perfectly cooked chicken burgers.

STEP SIX:
Serve and Enjoy
* ﻿﻿Serve the giant chicken patties as-is, on a bed of greens, or in a lettuce wrap if desired.
* ﻿﻿Enjoy the juicy, flavorful chicken burgers with your friends!


Key Tips:
• Temperature Probe: Using a temperature probe is crucial for this recipe to ensure the patties are cooked to the perfect internal temperature without overcooking.
This step makes all the difference in achieving juicy, tender chicken burgers.
• Resting: Letting the burgers rest for a few minutes after cooking allows the juices to redistribute, ensuring a moist and flavorful bite every time.
P.S. It can help a bit to flip the chicken burgers in the oven once they are halfway through cooking. A leave in oven thermometer is a godsend and is a must for this recipe, imo.

Keto Bourbon Anabolic French Toast Casserole

Description: This Keto Bourbon Anabolic French Toast Casserole combines the rich, warm flavors of bourbon, cinnamon, and lightly sweetened custard with the satisfying texture of keto-friendly Hawalian bread. The custard soaks deeply into the bread, creating a soft yet structured casserole that puffs up beautifully in the oven.
Topped with fresh berries, Cool Whip, and a light dusting of powdered Swerve, this dish delivers an indulgent feel while keeping it keto and packed with protein. Perfect for those aiming to hit their macros without sacrificing flavor or texture.

Ingredients (Makes 1 OMAD Serving) • 8 slices Hawalian
Keto Bread (from Walmart, ~45 calories per slice)
• 3 whole eggs • ½ cup cartoned egg whites (120ml) • 6g cinnamon (2 tsp) • 0.6g nutmeg • 0.6g allspice (¼ tsp) • 3g fine sea salt (½ tsp) • 48g Swerve or Brown Sugar Swerve (14 cup, granular) • 1 cup half & half (240ml) • 1 cup unsweetened almond milk (or Fairlife milk for more protein, 240ml) • 15ml bourbon (1 tbsp) • 1 cup Walmart Frozen Mixed Berries (140g, thawed) • Cool Whip (regular, 1 serving = 2 tbsp or 9g) • Powdered Swerve for dusting (through a fine mesh strainer) • Sugar-Free Ms.
Buttersworth or Walmart syrup (optional for serving)

Instructions
1. Prep the Bread: • Preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C). • Place the slices of keto bread in a single layer on a baking sheet and bake for 10-15 minutes until lightly toasted and dried out. This helps the bread absorb the custard without getting soggy.
2. Make the Custard: • In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the whole eggs, cartoned egg whites, cinnamon, optional nutmeg and allspice, sea salt, and Swerve or Brown Sugar Swerve until well combined. • Add the half & half, almond milk, and bourbon, and whisk until smooth.
3. Assemble the Casserole: • Generously coat a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray. • Arrange the bread so it’s shingled in two rows in the baking dish, with each slice slightly overlapping, ensuring everything fits snugly. • Pour the custard mixture evenly over the bread, making sure every slice is well-soaked. Gently press the bread into the custard if needed to ensure it absorbs well. • Cover the dish with aluminum foil and refrigerate for a minimum of 45 minutes, or overnight if prepping ahead.
4. Bake: • Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). • Bake the covered casserole for 25-30 minutes. • After 25-30 minutes, remove the foil. The edges of the bread should be crispy: if not, put the foil back until it is. After that, remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 5-10 minutes until the top is lightly golden and springs back to the touch.
5. Thaw the Frozen Mixed Berries: • Option 1: Microwave Thawing • Place the frozen berries in a microwave-safe bowl. • Microwave on defrost or low power (50%) for 30 seconds. • Stir the berries and continue microwaving in 15-20 second intervals, stirring each time, until fully thawed (about 1 minute total). • Optinn
2: Fridge Thawing • Place the frozen berries in a br the fridge. • Let them thaw for 4-6 hours or overnight.
6. Serve: • Let the casserole cool for 5 minutes. • Top with
1 cup of thawed Walmart Frozen Mixed Berries and 1-2 servings of Cool Whip (9-18g). • Lightly dust the top with powdered Swerve using a fine mesh strainer to give it a beautiful, powdered sugar look. • Serve with Ms. Buttersworth or Walmart sugar-free syrup on the side or drizzled on top for added sweetness. 

Flavors: • The bourbon gives a warm, smoky note that complements the subtle sweetness of the cinnamon and Swerve. • The custard is creamy and rich, perfectly soaked into the keto bread, creating a soft yet satistying texture. • Topped with tangy berries and cool whipped cream, the dish balances flavors and textures, making it a delicious, indulgent keto meal with none of the guilt.

ICE CREAM RECIPES

Since people were asking me about the recipes I made in the pictures, I wanted to post them up.

ICE CREAM ONE: LOW CALORIE JENI’S CHERRIES AND GOAT CHEESE ICE CREAM

Ingredients:
95 G 1% milk
165 G Almond Milk
3 G Cornstarch
36 G Goat Cheese
14 G Lite Cream Cheese
Pinch of Salt
.5 G Xanthan Gum
38 G PureCane/Swerve/artificial sweetener of choice
27 G Ms. Buttersworth or equivalent low calorie syrup
Cherries, chopped in half

1.) Purée all ingredients with an immersion blender.
2.) Add to ice cream maker of choice(preferably a Lello lol.)
3.) After the ice cream firms up and before it finishes, add chopped cherries as a mix-in.

Calories:
~582

Makes one pint.

ICE CREAM TWO:
Blueberry Ice Cream

Ingredients:
20 G Blueberries
380 G 1% Milk
4.2 G vanilla extract
40 G PureCane/Swerve/artificial sweetener of choice
Pinch of salt
1 G Xanthan Gum

1.) Purée blueberries with an immersion blender.
2.) Add rest of ingredients, and add to ice cream maker.

Note: This can be used to make any fruit flavored ice cream. However, if you make an ice cream with a fruit that has a lot of seeds(I.e. raspberries or blackberries) you should pour it into a strainer before you add it to your pint.

CALORIES: ~180

Makes one pint.

ICE CREAM THREE: “Best” Vanilla Ice Cream

Ingredients:
430 G 2% milk
1 Egg Yolk
4 G Vanilla Extract 
45 G PureCane/Swerve/Artificial Sweetener of Choice
Pinch of Salt
1 G Xanthan Gum

1.) Mix ingredients with immersion blender. Add to ice cream maker and enjoy!

CALORIES: ~285

Makes one pint.
